name: Shawn's Toolbox
description: Dreams panel (go through the nightly dream-connection days, filter unprocessed/processed/all, keep a connection with one tap = its pair line becomes a `- [ ]` checkbox, mark a day done via `dreams_reviewed`, add an optional 💭 "why I kept this" note to a kept connection, cross-day Kept view), highlights panel (per-day highlights:: capture with add/edit/delete, date picker, week/month/custom-range views, and an "on this day" retrospective), guiding-questions panel (pick sections to show together, whole-note fallback), pillars panel (cycle life pillars → per-pillar section cards, slot-reel wheel selector, per-pillar quick-capture inbox with voice dictation + auto-growing input), threads panel (thread areas grouping from an editable mapping note, Today's-thoughts processing view, #thread reading + reply + add-tag menu with new-thread creation, periodic-thought views + cadence + tagged/untagged filters, whole-vault scan, pin threads to top), inline threads code block (```threads: embed selected threads/cadences in any note), rich mentions footer (inline backlinks with full-line + child-subtree context, bare link-lists excluded), capture view (blank screen → daily-note sections, centred typing column on wide panes, long-press a just-captured thought to tag it with the same cadence/thread menu as the Threads panel), editable section cards, focus & voice panels (arm a cadence tag while recording a thought, record a highlight by voice), note status control, checkbox completion stamping, and block summarizer.
author: Shawn
